en: The image depicts an old postcard with sepia-toned photographs. The central area has the text 'Gruss aus Jacobstadt'. There are three black-and-white photo insets: one shows a church with a dome and cross, another shows a street with several buildings and people, and the third is an elevated view of a town with traditional European-style houses. The card is decorated with floral patterns and handwritten script in Russian.
